requirements.quote: the displacement referred to in annex 4, paragraph 3, to this Regulation shall not exceed 75 mm
requirements.text: The rear body structure of the vehicle shall limit the longitudinal displacement of the vertical projection of the floor of the "R" point of the rearmost seat, relative to a reference point on a non-deformed part of the structure, to not more than 75 mm after the rear-end impact test.

requirements.quote: the amount of longitudinal displacement of the vertical projection of the floor of the "R" point of the vehicle's rearmost seat
requirements.text: The rear impact attenuation structure shall be designed so that the residual longitudinal space can be measured as the longitudinal displacement of the vertical projection of the floor of the "R" point of the rearmost seat relative to a reference point on a non-deformed part of the vehicle structure.

requirements.quote: After the test, no rigid component in the passenger compartment shall constitute a risk of serious injury to the vehicle's occupants.
requirements.text: The rear body structure and the fuel tank mounting shall not, after the rear-end impact test, leave any rigid component in the passenger compartment that constitutes a risk of serious injury to the occupants.

requirements.quote: In addition, the side doors of the vehicle shall not open under the effect of the impact.
requirements.text: The rear body structure shall be sufficiently stiff that the side doors of the vehicle do not open under the effect of the rear impact.

requirements.quote: the opening of a number of doors sufficient to enable all the occupants to emerge shall, after the impact, continue to be possible without the use of tools
requirements.text: The rear body structure shall transfer rear impact loads so that, after the impact, opening of a number of doors sufficient to let all occupants emerge remains possible without the use of tools.

requirements.quote: The velocity of impact shall be between 35 and 38 km/h.
requirements.text: The rear impact attenuation structure shall withstand and be validated against a moving-barrier impact velocity of between 35 and 38 km/h.

requirements.quote: The aggregate weight (mass) of carriage and impactor shall be 1,100 ± 20 kg.
requirements.text: The rear body structure shall be validated against an impactor and carriage aggregate mass of 1,100 ± 20 kg applied to the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The impacting surface shall be flat, not less than 2,500 mm wide, and 800 mm high
requirements.text: The rear body structure, including the rear bumper crossbeam and crash boxes, shall be dimensioned to be struck by a flat impacting surface at least 2,500 mm wide and 800 mm high, and to engage that surface over the entire vehicle width.

requirements.quote: the ground clearance of the lower edge of the impacting surface shall be 175 ± 25 mm.
requirements.text: The rear crossbeam and crash boxes shall be positioned and shaped to engage an impactor whose lower edge is at a ground clearance of 175 ± 25 mm, so that the impact loads are taken by the rear rails and not by the fuel tank.

requirements.quote: the impacting surface shall be vertical and perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the impacted vehicle;
requirements.text: The rear rails and crossbeam shall be designed to take a vertical impact load perpendicular to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane and distributed symmetrically within 300 mm of that plane.

requirements.quote: The fuel tank must be filled to at least 90 % of its capacity with a liquid having a density close to that of the fuel normally used.
requirements.text: The fuel tank integrated in the rear structure shall be capable of being filled to at least 90 % of its capacity with a liquid of density close to that of the normal fuel for the impact test, so that the structure and tank are loaded at nearly full mass.

requirements.quote: The vehicle under test shall either be fitted with all the normal components and equipment included in its unladen kerb weight
requirements.text: The rear attenuation structure shall be tested with the vehicle carrying all normal components and equipment included in its unladen kerb weight, including the fuel tank and its mountings.

requirements.quote: The instruments used to record the speed referred to in paragraph 2.4.2. and 2.5.4. above shall be accurate to within 1 %.
requirements.text: The rear impact attenuation structure shall be validated in a test in which the impact speed is recorded with instruments accurate to within 1 %.

requirements.quote: shall be horizontal, flat and smooth and have a coefficient of friction of not less than 0.5
requirements.text: The rear structure with integrated fuel tank shall maintain its required performance when the rear impact is conducted on a horizontal, flat and smooth track with a coefficient of friction not less than 0.5.

requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections
requirements.text: The rear bumpers, crossbeam ends, tank shield and any other rear external surface of the structure shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or projections likely to increase the risk or seriousness of injury, both when stationary and in motion.

requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.text: The rear external parts of the structure, including the tank shield and bumper attachments, shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

requirements.quote: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.text: No protruding part of the rear external surface of the structure shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, except parts protruding less than 5 mm whose outward-facing angles are blunted, and parts protruding less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.quote: Protruding parts of the external surface, made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A, may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.text: Protruding parts of the rear external surface made of material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A, measured as installed on the vehicle, may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

requirements.quote: At a height of more than 2 metres, or
requirements.text: The external surface requirements shall be met for all rear structure parts that, with the vehicle laden and all doors, windows and lids closed, lie at a height not exceeding 2 m, above the floor line, and can be contacted by a 100 mm diameter sphere.

requirements.quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
requirements.text: The ends of the rear bumper and crossbeam shall be turned in towards the external surface so that either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork, or the bumper end cannot be contacted by a 100 mm sphere with a gap to the surrounding bodywork not exceeding 20 mm.

requirements.quote: that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward
requirements.text: The rear bumper contour, where it lies on a rigid surface, shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all points from the contour line to 20 mm inward within the central zone between the tangential points of the two 15° vertical planes, and 2.5 mm in all other cases.

requirements.quote: which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers
requirements.text: Parts on or of the rear bumper, such as joint covers, with a projection of less than 5 mm need not meet the bumper curvature requirement, but their outward-facing angles shall be blunted unless they protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.quote: The projection shall not exceed 40 mm in the case of door or luggage compartment handles and 30 mm in all other cases.
requirements.text: Projections of the fuel tank filler cap or cover on the rear external surface shall not exceed 30 mm measured by the specified method.

requirements.quote: Sheet-metal edges, such as gutter edges and the rails of sliding doors, shall not be permitted unless they are folded back or are fitted with a shield
requirements.text: Sheet-metal edges of the welded steel rear structure, including the tank shield and closing panel edges, shall be folded back by approximately 180° or turned towards the bodywork so that they cannot be contacted by a 100 mm sphere, or be fitted with a shield meeting this Regulation.

requirements.quote: Folds in body panels may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm provided that it is not less than one-tenth of the height "H" of the projection
requirements.text: Folds in the rear body panels and closing panel may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm provided it is not less than one-tenth of the projection height H measured per Annex 3.

requirements.quote: The jacking brackets and exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them.
requirements.text: Any jacking brackets and exhaust pipe on the rear structure shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line above them, and an exhaust pipe projecting further shall terminate in rounded edges of at least 2.5 mm radius.

requirements.quote: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation
requirements.text: Rear registration plate supporting brackets provided on the structure shall comply with the 2.5 mm minimum radius of curvature requirement if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere with a plate fitted as recommended.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.
requirements.text: The approval mark affixed to the vehicle for the rear structure shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: a= 8 mm min
requirements.text: The approval mark affixed to the vehicle shall have a minimum dimension a of 8 mm as shown in Annex 2 Model A.
